description: This 2019 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 Custom is built to handle the work and adventures you demand from your truck. With its commanding presence, proven reliability, and comprehensive features, this 4WD pickup delivers the capability and comfort you need whether you're jobsite-bound or exploring new terrain.  - 4WD capability with heavy-duty locking rear differential - Remote vehicle starter system with theft deterrent - SiriusXM Radio and OnStar with 4G LTE connectivity - Rear backup camera with hitch guidance system - EZ Lift power lock and release tailgate - Trailering package with hitch and connectors - LED cargo area lighting for nighttime visibility - Remote keyless entry with panic alarm - Heated power mirrors for winter driving - Electric rear-window defogger - Bluetooth connectivity with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto - Power windows and power door locks throughout - Electronic stability control and traction control - Multiple airbags for occupant protection  The Silverado 1500 Custom combines practical truck design with genuine daily-driver convenience. The EcoTec3 4.3L V6 engine paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission delivers balanced performance and capability. The 4WD system with heavy-duty locking rear differential ensures you maintain traction across challenging terrain and weather conditions. Inside, you'll find cloth seating that's easy to maintain, a digital display with trip computer information, and climate control to keep you comfortable year-round.  Your connection to the road stays strong with the Chevrolet Infotainment 3 System, featuring a 3.5-inch display, AM/FM radio with data system, Bluetooth phone connectivity, and both Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration. SiriusXM Radio keeps your entertainment fresh, while OnStar with Chevrolet Connected Services provides peace of mind. The included remote vehicle starter means your truck is ready when you are.  The Custom Convenience Package adds genuine value through remote start capability, rear-window defogger, bed LED lighting, and the EZ Lift tailgatefeatures that make truck ownership more practical. The Trailering Package includes the hitch system with both 7-pin and 4-pin connectors, plus Hitch Guidance to simplify backing up your trailer. LED cargo lighting ensures you can load and unload safely in any lighting condition.  Safety is integrated throughout this truck with six airbags including front, side, and overhead protection, ABS brakes with brake assist, electronic stability control, and low tire pressure warning. The rear backup camera and parking sensors give you confidence when maneuvering in tight spaces. Heated power mirrors defrost quickly, and the multiple airbag system provides protection for all occupants.  This Silverado 1500 Custom represents a solid opportunity to own a capable, well-equipped truck ready for work or weekend adventure. With electronic stability control, traction control, and brake assist working together, you'll navigate various driving conditions with confidence.  The interior combines everyday practicality with considerate details. Heated front seats keep you comfortable during colder months, while the front center armrest and rear seat center armrest provide convenient storage and support. The split folding rear seat adapts to your needs, whether you're transporting passengers or maximizing cargo space. Overhead and reading lights make the cabin more functional, and the trip computer helps you monitor fuel efficiency.  Safety features throughout include 4-wheel disc brakes with ABS, dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, and overhead airbags positioned to protect occupants in multiple scenarios. The occupant sensing airbag system adds an extra layer of protection, while low tire pressure warning keeps you informed about your vehicle's condition.  Practical additions enhance ownership convenience. The combination roadside kit comes ready in your vehicle, containing essential items for minor roadside situations. The included VW Care prepaid maintenance contract gives you scheduled servicing peace of mind, and the Emergency Communication System provides security when needed.  This Tiguan is a capable choice for drivers seeking a dependable SUV that handles daily responsibilities without complications.  All prices plus tax, tag, and fees. Practical features make daily operation straightforward.
